flags.why: Calling someone đui can be offensive, which the colloquial tag alone does not warn about ([Wiktionary](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/đui)).
In the second example, không thể means 'cannot', whereas 'should' introduces an obligation absent from the Vietnamese.
flags.fix: There can be no cultural supremacy.

flags.why: The entry omits the common derogatory use referring to a person addicted to drugs ([VDict](https://vdict.com/x%C3%AC-%20ke%2C3%2C0%2C0.html)).
The common meaning of gaining experience through practical challenges or competition is missing ([Wiktionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/cọ_xát)).
flags.fix: Add verb: to gain practical experience through challenges or competition; example: Các cầu thủ trẻ cần cọ xát với những đội mạnh. = The young players need to gain experience by playing against strong teams.
